svg.title: Design reference - source page 81
svg.desc: LEFENG CHIBI SCENIC AREA HOT SPRING RESORT HOTEL Functional Zoning PLAN KEY • Yellow · Children’s play • Red · Restaurant • Orange · Business and family area • Green · Private treehouse hot springs • Blue · Public changing rooms, control room, spa and premium accommodation • Light green · Woodland hot springs YUANWANG / HOT SPRING DESIGN 081 / 118 Drawing-label key: 入口 = entrance; 出口 = exit; 前厅/接待 = lobby/reception; 更衣室 = changing room; 男更衣 = men's changing; 女更衣 = women's changing; 淋浴 = showers; 卫生间 = WC; 泳池 = swimming pool; 儿童池 = children's pool; 泡池 = bathing pool; 私汤 = private bath; 水疗 = hydrotherapy; 水吧 = poolside bar; 休息区 = rest area; 设备间/机房 = plant room; 储藏 = store; 办公 = office; 餐厅 = restaurant; 楼梯 = stairs; 电梯 = lift; 水景 = water feature; 绿地 = landscaped area; 总平面图 = master plan; 首层/一层 = ground floor; 二层 = first floor; 剖面图 = section; 图例 = legend. Original English numbered legends are retained.
